title: PaymentReconcileRequest
description: The input of payment.reconcile: the proposal of a payment.execute whose outcome is unknown, as a URI. DSoR asks the company's bank, by the key it derived from this proposal, what happened, and settles the proposal COMMITTED or FAILED with the bank's answer as evidence; a bank that does not answer settles nothing (DSOR-UNK-04a; step 38's README, decisions D1 and D2). This tutorial's own schema: the specification names a reconciliation process, not its operation.
